skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to draft internal communications using company-style formats for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
skill.summary: Draft internal communications with structured formats for company updates, FAQs, newsletters, and 3P reports.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

content.value_statement: Internal updates often need clear structure and consistent tone. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to draft newsletters, 3P updates, FAQs, and employee communications.
actual_capabilities: Selects a guideline format based on the requested communication type.
Drafts 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates company newsletters with concise bullets for Slack and email.
Formats employee FAQ responses with short questions and answers.
Guides general communications by clarifying audience, purpose, tone, and format.
Encourages links to authoritative internal sources when available.
limitations: Does not connect to Slack, email, calendar, or documents without separate tool access.
Does not verify confidential or sensitive information automatically.
Reflects one company's preferred formats and may need adaptation.
Cannot replace legal, HR, or executive approval for official announcements.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team 3P Update
use_cases.description: Turn team notes into a concise Progress, Plans, and Problems update for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Company Newsletter Draft
use_cases.description: Summarize major announcements, milestones, and social updates into a readable company-wide newsletter.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ Response
use_cases.description: Collect common employee questions and draft clear answers based on official source material.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the [team name] team covering [date range]. Use these notes for Progress, Plans, and Problems: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter Section
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a company-wide update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter section for [topic]. Use short bullets, first-person company voice, and links from these source notes: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Build an Employee FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an employee FAQ from these questions and source notes. Keep each answer to one or two sentences and flag uncertain answers: [paste material].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Leadership-Ready Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with mixed sources and review needs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these Slack, email, calendar, and document notes. Draft an executive-ready internal update, group related items, cite source links, and identify gaps needing owner review.

output_examples.input: Draft a weekly 3P update for the Platform team using notes about reliability work, migration plans, and staffing risks.
output_examples.output:
Platform Team (June 24 to June 30)
Progress: We improved service reliability and completed the first migration batch.
Plans: We will finish the second migration batch and publish the rollout checklist.
Problems: Staffing gaps may slow incident follow-up unless ownership is confirmed.

output_examples.input: Create a company newsletter from notes about a launch, hiring progress, and a leadership all-hands.
output_examples.output:
Company Announcements
- We launched the new customer dashboard and shared adoption metrics with the company.
- We welcomed five new teammates across product, sales, and support.

Leadership Updates
- The all-hands covered quarterly priorities and linked the operating plan for review.

output_examples.input: Turn common employee questions about a policy change into an FAQ.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does the new policy start?
Answer: The policy starts on Monday. Employees should review the linked announcement before then.

Question: Who can answer follow-up questions?
Answer: People Operations owns follow-up questions and will collect feedback this week.

best_practices: Provide source notes, dates, audience, and links before asking for a draft.
Review sensitive details before sharing any company-wide communication.
Ask the responsible executive, HR, or legal owner to approve high-impact announcements.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent metrics, decisions, or source links.
Do not publish drafts as official communications without owner review.
Do not mix leadership, team, and company-wide audiences in one unclear request.

faq.question: What types of communications does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, employee FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does it access Slack, email, or documents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can use those sources only when the host assistant has separate authorized tool access.

faq.question: Can it write in a specific company style?
faq.answer: Yes. It follows the included guideline files and can adapt when users provide style notes.

faq.question: How should I prepare a request?
faq.answer: Include the audience, date range, communication type, source notes, important links, and any required approval context.

faq.question: Can it handle confidential information?
faq.answer: It can format provided information, but users must review confidentiality, access limits, and sharing rules before publication.

faq.question: Is this only for Claude?
faq.answer: No. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
